errors.text_span: 右侧Y轴为数值轴，单位为准确率，刻度从0线性递增至1，数值间隔为0.2
errors.evidence: The right y-axis tick labels in the figure increase by 0.1 (0, 0.1, 0.2, ..., 1.0), not 0.2.
The description does not mention that the right y-axis accuracy scale uses 0.1 tick intervals, which is an explicit axis detail shown in the figure and in the reference.
